verdict.rationale: vLLM is an LLM inference and serving engine. Chatting with local documents through built-in RAG is a fair question for local-LLM tooling, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only building blocks: an OpenAI-compatible server, offline inference, and tool calling. Nothing documents document ingestion, indexing, automatic retrieval, or a document-chat interface, and building blocks earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can chat with my own documents entirely offline using automatic retrieval-augmented generation
